notes.title: BugFix(v20250121.1)
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been fixed.
・Fixed a bug where the first intermediate point of the Hasunoha Nossu stage was misaligned.

notes.title: Bug fixes + changes (v20241219.2)
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been fixed.
-Fixed an issue where you could not climb up on the back 3 sides because there was a floor in front of the ladder.
- Eliminated some pixel art garbage in the background.
-Fixed an issue where some data would not be initialized if the button was held down when continuing.

The following changes have been made.
- Made it possible to return to the title after the ending.

notes.title: BugFix(v20241218.1)
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been fixed.
-Fixed an issue where the restart position was incorrect when losing the remaining units in the middle of the second side.

notes.title: BugFix(v20241217.1)
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been fixed.
- Closed the gap in the 1-block abyss behind the cloud on the back side.

postscript:
-Fixed an issue where there was a ladder on the Parphegor stage where the screen could not be moved.

notes.title: BugFix(v20241215.1)
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been fixed.
・From the time the game ends until you can use the keys on the continue screen,
Fixed an issue where the remaining units would not be initialized if the OK button was held down.
-Fixed an issue where some achievements would not notify when the conditions were met.

notes.title: This game is now available for purchase in Germany.
notes.notes:
Ratings were set and approved so that it could be sold in Germany.
Please enjoy it.

notes.title: Bug Fix(v20241214.1)
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been fixed.
-Fixed an issue where processing was delayed on the back 4 sides.

However, since it has not been reproduced on the developer's PC, it is not possible to confirm whether the issue was actually resolved.

notes.title: Bug Fix (v20241213.1)
notes.notes:
We have made the following corrections.
-Fixed an issue where the boss on the back 4th floor would immediately move on to the next attack when it was attacked.
- Items were placed in meaningless spaces on the Nossu stage.

notes.title: Bug fix + specification change + α (v20241212.3)
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been fixed.
-Fixed a bug where the surface clear flag would not stand after clearing the stage (degradation)
-Fixed a bug where you could return to the main screen while recovering ether on the menu screen.
・Fixed an issue where the player would be teleported when using ether on the menu screen.

The following specifications have been changed.
-Changed so that ether does not disappear when continuing (specification change)
・Changed the middle point of the Nossu-san stage from being a screen with a bell to the next screen.

notes.title: 致命的不具合＋αの修正(ver20241211.2)
notes.notes:
We have quickly fixed the following fatal bug.
-Fixed an issue where the enemy's defeat flag was not falling properly when continuing on the back 4th page.
・Fixed an issue where after defeating the mid-boss in the Lanny stage, the wall on the left disappears and you enter subspace.

notes.title: First fix immediately after release(ver20241211.1)
notes.notes:
We have fixed the following bugs that were reported immediately after release.
-You can now jump while pressing "up" on the cross key.
-Added this because there was no damage detection at the first fall point on the back side.
-There were places on the back two sides that were buried in walls, so the terrain was changed.
